$comment: The travel day's cases, run by both clients: app/abeona/src/lib/travelday.test.ts (npm run test:abeona) and android/abeona's TravelDayFixturesTest (copied into its test resources by Gradle with transfer.fixtures.json). Change a rule in travelday.ts and domain/TravelDay.kt together, and the case here once. Stops: omitted fields are null. Legs: mode defaults to train, cancelled to false. Instants compare as instants.

travelDay.name: before leaving: leave 15 min before the departure
half a minute to leave rounds up
at the station once it is time to leave
no time to the station: leave when the train does
a late departure moves the time to leave
a cancelled first ride is still the one at the station
on board the first ride
changing between the rides
a late arrival keeps you on board
on board the last ride
the last ride's live arrival decides when it is over
arrived
walks are not rides: changing to the bus after the walk
only a walk: nothing to ride
on-board Wi-Fi confirms the ride
on-board Wi-Fi on the first train after the second left: missed the change
on-board Wi-Fi wins over the position
on-board Wi-Fi naming a walk is ignored
near the first stop before it is time to leave: at the station
far from the first stop: still before leaving
moving along the ride's line: on board, confirmed
on the line but slow: not confirmed
standing at the change station after the train left: missed
standing at the change station one minute after: not yet missed
standing at the first stop after the train left: missed it
changing, but still moving along the first ride: on board it
changing, at the change station: confirmed

alternativesOrigin.name: before leaving: the first stop, now
on board: the next stopover, at its arrival
on board past the last stopover: where the ride ends
on board the last ride, nothing left before the destination: none

alternativesReason.name: on board towards a change at risk
a change at risk already behind

missedShortConnection.name: by the position, a change of 10 minutes: not short
by the position, a change of 3 minutes (first train 7 late): short
by the train's Wi-Fi only, even a short change does not count
the first train is no change
